privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: membrs helps you find events, opportunities and places worth your time. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, why we collect it, who we share it with and the choices you have. We collect as little as we can and we never sell your data. Questions go to privacy@membrs.xyz.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy as membrs changes. If we make a meaningful change, we will update the date at the end of this page and tell subscribers in the next digest before it takes effect.

sections.heading: Collecting your personal information
paragraphs: "Personal information" means information that identifies you or could reasonably be linked to you.
membrs decides how and why your personal information is used, and is responsible for it under data protection law.
membrs is not intended for anyone under 16, and we do not knowingly collect information from them. If you believe a child has given us their email, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use a small number of cookies and local storage on your device. Essential ones keep the site working and remember your choices, such as dark mode and your city. Analytics and marketing cookies are only set if you say yes.
See our Cookie Policy for the full list. You can change your choice any time from Cookie settings, linked in the footer of every page.

sections.heading: How we use your information

paragraphs.text: We use your personal information to:
items: send the Sunday digest and early access news for the city you chose;
send promotional emails, such as offers and featured picks, because you agreed to this when you subscribed;
tune the digest to the interests you picked;
answer questions you send to Ask membrs;
review the Listings you submit and place the ads you pay for;
find broken links, outdated hours and Listings that need checking;
keep membrs secure and fix errors;
understand which pages and Listings are useful; and
meet our legal obligations.

paragraphs: We do not sell, rent or trade your information, and we do not use it for third party advertising.

sections.heading: Consent
paragraphs: We ask for your consent before we send the digest or promotional emails, and before we turn on analytics or marketing cookies.
You can withdraw your consent at any time by unsubscribing or changing your Cookie settings. Withdrawing it does not affect what we did before.

sections.heading: Lawful basis for processing
paragraphs: Consent for the digest, promotional emails, analytics and marketing cookies.
Contract for running your account, reviewing your submissions and placing the ads you pay for.
Legitimate interests for keeping membrs secure, fixing errors and understanding which Listings are useful, in ways you would reasonably expect.
Legal obligation where the law requires us to keep or share information.

sections.heading: How we collect your personal information
paragraphs: From you, when you subscribe, ask membrs a question, or submit a Listing, promo or ad.
Automatically, as basic usage data when you use membrs, and through the cookies you allow.
From our payment provider, Bachs, which tells us the amount, status and reference of an ad payment.

sections.heading: The personal information we collect
paragraphs: Your email address. That address is all we receive when you subscribe, ask a question or send us a Listing. There is no password.
Your city and interests when you subscribe to the digest, together with your consent to receive it and our promotional emails. Telling us about your field of work is optional.
What you send us. Events, opportunities and ads you submit, including any photo and the contact details you put in the form.
Ad payments. The amount, status and payment reference. We never see your card or bank details.
Your questions to Ask membrs, as described in section 12.
What you search for. Searches rank results in the moment. Your recent searches are kept only on your own device.
Basic usage data such as pages viewed and the device type, collected without identifying you.
Calendars and reminders. When you add something to your calendar, membrs fills in the details and hands them to the app you choose. We never read, store or sync your calendar.

sections.heading: Third-party technologies

paragraphs.text: We use trusted providers to run membrs. Each receives only what it needs for its job:
items: Google, for the spreadsheets we keep subscriber and submission records in;
Bachs, for ad payments;
Anthropic, to answer questions sent to Ask membrs;
PostHog, to measure how membrs is used, as described in section 3; and
our email delivery and hosting providers.

paragraphs: They work under contracts that limit what they can do with your data.

sections.heading: Location services
paragraphs: If you have already allowed location for membrs in your browser, your location is used on your device to show Listings near you. It is never sent to us.
You can turn location off for membrs in your browser settings at any time.

sections.heading: Communication
paragraphs: We email the digest, early access news and, if you agreed, promotional emails to the address you gave us.
We also send service emails, such as the welcome email and replies to your requests.
The digest may include a tracking pixel and tracked links so we can see whether emails are opened and which picks are popular. You can turn off images in your email app to block the pixel.

sections.heading: Ask membrs
paragraphs: Questions you send to Ask membrs go to our AI provider, Anthropic, together with your interests and city, so it can answer them.
The current chat is kept only until you start a new one or the day ends.
Please do not include sensitive personal information in your questions.

sections.heading: Disclosures of your personal information

paragraphs.text: We share personal information only with:
items: the service providers named in section 9;
authorities, courts or regulators, when the law requires it; and
anyone we need to share it with to protect people from harm, or to protect membrs from fraud or abuse.

paragraphs: Organisers do not get your details from us. When you get a ticket or apply, you leave membrs for the Organiser's own page.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
paragraphs: Details you put in a Listing you submit, such as a contact number for the event, are shown publicly on membrs. Only include what you are happy for readers to see.

sections.heading: Storage and security
paragraphs: Data is encrypted in transit and stored with providers that meet recognised security standards. Access is limited to the people who need it to run membrs.

Some of our providers store data outside the country you live in. When that happens we rely on safeguards recognised by the applicable law, such as standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision, so your data keeps the same level of protection.
No system is perfectly secure, so we keep what we hold to a minimum.

sections.heading: Retention period
paragraphs: We keep your email, city and interests until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete them. After that they are removed from our systems within 30 days.
We keep submissions for as long as the Listing is shown and for 12 months after, so we can answer questions about it.
We keep ad payment records for as long as tax and accounting law requires.

sections.heading: Direct marketing
paragraphs: We only send promotional emails to subscribers who agreed to receive them.
Every email has a one click unsubscribe link.
Marketing cookies, if you turn them on, only measure our own campaigns on other sites. We do not let advertisers on membrs track you across sites.

sections.heading: Links to other websites
paragraphs: Listings link to sites we do not control, such as ticketing platforms and application portals. Their privacy policies apply there, and we are not responsible for how they handle your information.

sections.heading: Access and corrections to personal information
paragraphs: You have rights over the personal information we hold about you.

items: show you the information we hold and give you a copy;
correct anything that is wrong;
export it in a portable format;
delete it;
stop or limit using it for a particular purpose; or
withdraw a consent you gave.

paragraphs: Email privacy@membrs.xyz from the address the request is about. We may ask you to confirm the address is yours before we act.
We reply within 30 days.

Depending on where you live, laws such as the Nigeria Data Protection Act, Ghana's Data Protection Act, Kenya's Data Protection Act, the UK GDPR or the EU GDPR may give you further rights. We honour these requests wherever you are.
We may keep some information after a deletion request where the law requires it, such as ad payment records.

sections.heading: Data protection contact
paragraphs: Questions, requests and complaints about your personal information go to privacy@membrs.xyz.

If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, contact us first and we will try to fix it. You can also complain to your data protection authority, such as the Nigeria Data Protection Commission, the Data Protection Commission of Ghana, Kenya's Office of the Data Protection Commissioner or the UK Information Commissioner's Office.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: This policy is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, including the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, without affecting protections you have where you live.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of membrs, including the website, the Sunday digest and the app when it opens. Please read them carefully before you use membrs. If anything here is unclear, email hello@membrs.xyz.

sections.heading: General terms
paragraphs: In these Terms, "membrs", "we", "us" and "our" mean the team that runs membrs, and "you" means anyone who uses it.

The "Platform" means the membrs website, the Sunday digest (the "Digest"), the app and every email we send. A "Listing" is an event, opportunity, place or promo shown on the Platform. An "Organiser" is the person or business behind a Listing.
By using the Platform you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Listing Guidelines and Advertising Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Platform.
The Platform is not intended for anyone under 16.

sections.heading: Services
paragraphs: membrs is a discovery service. We list events, opportunities and places, and link you to the official page to get a ticket, apply or visit.
We do not sell tickets, process applications or run the venues we list. The only payment we take is for ads.
Listings come from Organisers, public ticketing platforms and our own research. We may add, change or remove any Listing at any time.

sections.heading: Accessing the Platform
paragraphs: You may use the Platform for lawful, personal purposes.
We work to keep the Platform available, but it may be unavailable at times for maintenance, upgrades or reasons outside our control.
You are responsible for the device, connection and software you use to reach the Platform.

sections.heading: Your email and account
paragraphs: You give us your email address to subscribe to the Digest, ask membrs a question or send us a Listing. There is no password. Use an address that is yours.
You are responsible for what is submitted from a browser that holds your address. If someone else uses your address, the link in our welcome email stops all membrs email to it.
You can make this browser forget your email at any time, and ask us to delete your account from privacy@membrs.xyz.

sections.heading: Payment
paragraphs: Browsing the Platform, reading Listings and receiving the Digest are free.
Ads are paid for in advance through our payment provider, Bachs. We never see your card or bank details.
An ad runs for the number of days you paid for once it passes review. Paying for a placement does not buy a review, a ranking in Most Popular or a mention in the Digest.
Tickets, fees and applications you pay for on an Organiser's site are paid to the Organiser, not to membrs.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The membrs name, design, writing and Digest belong to us.
Organisers keep the rights to their names, descriptions and images.
You may share links to the Platform freely. You may not copy its content in bulk or present it as your own.

sections.heading: No reliance
paragraphs: We check Listings before they go live, but Organisers can change dates, prices, deadlines, eligibility and opening hours at any time.
Where an Organiser has not published a price, we show Tickets soon until they do.
Always confirm the details on the official page before you travel, pay or apply.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The Platform is provided as is. We do not guarantee that it will always be accurate, complete or available.
To the extent the law allows, membrs is not liable for losses that come from relying on a Listing, from an event or opportunity itself, or from a third party site.
Nothing in these Terms limits rights you have that cannot be limited by law.

sections.heading: Indemnification
paragraphs: If you submit a Listing, promo or ad that breaks these Terms or someone else's rights, you agree to cover the reasonable costs, losses and claims membrs faces because of it.

sections.heading: Term and termination
paragraphs: These Terms apply from when you first use the Platform until you stop.
You can stop using membrs and unsubscribe at any time.
We may suspend or end access for anyone who breaks these Terms or puts other people at risk.

paragraphs.text: When you use the Platform, you must not:
items: scrape, copy in bulk or access the Platform with automated tools without our written permission;
try to break, overload or interfere with the Platform or its security;
misuse search or Ask membrs, including trying to make it produce harmful content;
submit a Listing, promo or ad that is false, misleading, unlawful or infringes someone else's rights;
use an email address that is not yours; or
use the Platform to send spam or collect other people's information.

sections.heading: Electronic communication
paragraphs: When you subscribe, you agree to receive the Digest and occasional promotional emails from membrs. The Digest is free.
You can unsubscribe from either at any time from the link in every email.
Subscribers get early access when the app opens in their city. We cannot promise a specific date.
Notices we send you by email or show on the Platform count as written notice.

sections.heading: Severability
paragraphs: If any part of these Terms is found to be unenforceable, the rest of these Terms stays in effect.

sections.heading: Personal data
paragraphs: Our Privacy Policy explains what we collect, why we collect it and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Breaches of these Terms
paragraphs: If you break these Terms, we may remove your submissions, stop emailing you, refuse future submissions or ads, or suspend your access, depending on how serious the breach is.
Where the law requires it, we may report a breach to the relevant authorities.

sections.heading: Submitting Listings and promos
paragraphs: If you submit an event, opportunity, place or promo, you confirm that it is accurate, that you are allowed to share it, and that you have the rights to any image you upload.
You give membrs a free, worldwide licence to show, edit for length and clarity, and share your submission on the Platform and in the Digest.
Submissions must follow our Listing Guidelines. We may decline, edit or remove any submission at our discretion.

sections.heading: Advertising and sponsored Listings
paragraphs: Some Listings are paid placements. They always carry an Ad badge.
Paid placements are reviewed to the same standard as every other Listing and must follow our Advertising Policy.

sections.heading: Complaints and reports
paragraphs: If a Listing is wrong, misleading, unsafe or infringes your rights, email report@membrs.xyz with the link. We review reports within 2 working days and take Listings down when needed.
For anything else, email hello@membrs.xyz.

sections.heading: Tickets, refunds and cancellations
paragraphs: membrs does not sell tickets. Tickets, refunds, cancellations and changes to an event are handled by the Organiser or ticketing platform you bought from, under their own terms.
If an event on the Platform is cancelled or moved, tell us at report@membrs.xyz and we will update or remove the Listing.

sections.heading: Third party sites
paragraphs: Links on the Platform take you to sites we do not control, such as ticketing platforms and application portals. Their terms and privacy policies apply there, and any purchase or application is between you and them.

sections.heading: Promos and offers
paragraphs: Promos and offers on the Platform are run by the businesses behind them, who set and honour their own conditions.
A promo can change or end early if the business changes it. Check the conditions on the business's own page before you rely on it.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, without affecting any consumer protections you have where you live.
If a dispute arises, contact us first at hello@membrs.xyz and we will try to resolve it with you directly.

sections.heading: Version control
paragraphs: We may update these Terms as membrs grows. If a change matters, we will update the date below and mention it in the Digest before it applies.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains the cookies and similar technologies membrs uses, what each one does and how you control them. Cookies are small files saved on your device. We also use local storage, which works in a similar way.

sections.heading: Our approach
paragraphs: Only essential cookies are set when you first visit. Analytics and marketing cookies stay off until you choose to turn them on.
You can change your choice at any time from Cookie settings, which is also linked in the footer of every page.

sections.heading: Essential cookies (always on)
paragraphs: membrs.theme remembers dark or light mode. Kept until you clear it.
membrs.cookies remembers your cookie choice. Kept for 12 months.
membrs.user and membrs.refresh remember the email you gave us, so we do not ask again. Removed when you tell this browser to forget it.
membrs.city and recent searches remember your city and searches on your own device only. They are never sent to us.
membrs.interests, membrs.fields and membrs.joined remember the digest picks you chose, so the digest card opens with them.
membrs.outbox and form drafts hold a listing you are writing or sending, including its photo, until it is sent or you clear the form.
membrs.tour remembers that you have seen the tour.
Security and load balancing cookies set by our hosting provider to keep the site fast and protected. Session only.

sections.heading: Analytics cookies (optional)
paragraphs: Help us understand which pages and listings are useful, using privacy friendly, aggregated measurement. They do not identify you and are never used for advertising.
Kept for up to 13 months. Only set if you turn on Analytics.

sections.heading: Marketing cookies (optional)
paragraphs: Let us measure whether our own campaigns on other sites bring people to membrs, and avoid showing you ads for membrs you have already acted on.
We do not let advertisers on membrs track you across sites. Only set if you turn on Marketing.

sections.heading: Emails
paragraphs: The digest may include a tracking pixel and tracked links so we can see whether emails are opened and which picks are popular. You can turn off images in your email app to block the pixel, or unsubscribe at any time.

sections.heading: Managing cookies in your browser
paragraphs: Besides Cookie settings, you can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may stop parts of membrs from working, such as remembering your city.

sections.heading: Contact us
paragraphs: Questions about cookies: privacy@membrs.xyz.

guidelines.title: Listing Guidelines
guidelines.intro: membrs only works if people can trust what they find here. These guidelines apply to everything listed on membrs, whether it is submitted for free or paid for as an ad.

sections.heading: What we list
paragraphs: Events, opportunities, places and promos that are real, open to the public or a clear audience, and happening in a city we cover.
Every listing needs an official link where people can get a ticket, apply, book or visit.

sections.heading: Accuracy
paragraphs: Dates, prices, deadlines, eligibility and locations must be correct when submitted and kept up to date.
Say clearly if something is free, paid, invite only or requires an application fee.

sections.heading: What we do not list
paragraphs: Scams, pyramid or multi level marketing schemes, and opportunities that ask applicants to pay to be considered without saying so.
Anything illegal, hateful, sexually explicit or that encourages harm.
Gambling, weapons, tobacco, vapes and prescription drugs.
Copies of someone else's event or opportunity without their permission.

sections.heading: Images and words
paragraphs: Use images you own or have permission to use. No misleading photos, text heavy flyers or images of people used without consent.
Write plainly. No all caps, clickbait or exaggerated claims.

sections.heading: Review and removal
paragraphs: Every submission is checked by a person before it goes live, usually within 2 working days.
We may edit for clarity, ask for proof, decline or remove a listing. Repeated breaches can lead to a ban.

sections.heading: Report a listing
paragraphs: Spotted something wrong or unsafe? Email report@membrs.xyz with the link.

advertising.title: Advertising Policy
advertising.intro: membrs is free for readers because of advertisers. This policy keeps ads honest and useful for the people who see them.

sections.heading: How ads appear
paragraphs: Ads appear as the first listing in a collection and always carry an Ad badge.
Ads look like the listings around them so they are easy to read, but they are never hidden or disguised.

sections.heading: What can be advertised
paragraphs: Anything that meets our Listing Guidelines, plus extra rules for regulated areas.
Financial products must be from licensed providers and show key terms clearly. Alcohol ads are only shown to an adult audience and must follow local law.
Political and election ads are not accepted.

sections.heading: Independence
paragraphs: Ads do not affect Most Popular, Closing Soon, search results or what the editors pick for the digest.
We never sell or share subscriber data with advertisers.

sections.heading: Payment and refunds
paragraphs: Prices and dates are agreed before a placement goes live. If we reject or remove an ad for a reason that is not the advertiser's fault, unused days are refunded.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: To advertise, use the Advertise form or email ads@membrs.xyz.
